review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked each new definition against the Mathlib concept it might compete with. stageProductCoordinatePullback is a composition of `MvPolynomial.rename` with `polynomialEquiv.symm`. stageProductCoordinateKill is a thin named specialisation of `MvPolynomial.killCompl`. stageProductSpecRename and stageProductSpecKill are `algSpec.map` applied to those two maps. unitriangularStageUnderlyingSpecIso composes existing isomorphisms. All of these reuse the Mathlib constructions and add named, typed API for this specific setting, and they come with the lemmas the file's own proofs use, so I did not count them as competing concepts. stageSuperdiagonalInclusion is a bespoke subtype injection between index types specific to this library. I found no Mathlib concept for it. Separately, `survivingInclusion` in AlgebraicGroups/Algebra/UnitriangularStagePolynomial.lean is a library-internal near-neighbour of the injections here, but the rubric covers duplication of Mathlib concepts, so I did not report it. I found no avoidable Mathlib duplicate. I did not run Lean, and I did not do an exhaustive search of Mathlib's AlgebraicGeometry directory for alternatives to the over-scheme section constructions.
